title: Game Angry Referee Soul
description: Referee philosophical foundation: prepare skeletons, not scripted outcomes; let player choices add flesh.

runtime.contextSummary: On-demand Referee soul card. Keep a tiny hard-coded Referee identity/capability boundary in baseline context, then load this when framing/adjudication philosophy matters.

safetyPolicy: Do not invent Game Angry claims. Use source pointers and keep hidden/player-private data out of public output.
outputShape: Operating principles plus a short checklist for framing and adjudication.

title: Frame Situation
description: Frame the current table-visible situation from the Referee Situation Graph without forcing a path.

runtime.contextSummary: Loaded when Referee needs to present the next table situation or current affordances.

safetyPolicy: Read table projection; do not reveal hidden graph nodes, raw Referee notes, or player private memory.
outputShape: Table-facing narration, visible affordances, concise public process note.

title: Adjudicate Player Action
description: Resolve a declared PlayerAgent action against visible state, hidden truth, dice, and applicable OSE procedure.

runtime.contextSummary: Loaded for resolving uncertain player actions and choosing when to consult OSE procedure.

safetyPolicy: Never replace player intent with a railroad. If rules matter, request OSE receipt IDs.
outputShape: Outcome, consequences, dice/procedure receipt IDs, next question, private Referee note.

title: Update Referee Brain
description: Compress beat consequences into durable Referee Brain notes without dumping raw transcript.

runtime.contextSummary: Loaded after meaningful beats to update hidden fronts, NPC memory, latent encounters, clocks, receipts, and unresolved questions.

safetyPolicy: Store private Referee notes only in Referee repo/context. Do not write player private memories into Referee Brain.
outputShape: Compact markdown sections for graph changes, NPC memory, clocks, latent encounters, receipts, open questions.

title: Create Village Skeleton
description: Generate the initial Referee Situation Graph: locations, NPCs, rumors, hooks, clocks, latent encounters, and affordances.

runtime.contextSummary: Loaded during setup or explicit world-maintenance, not during ordinary action resolution.

safetyPolicy: Generate structure, not outcomes. Factions are advanced/future. Public projection gets only visible pieces.

title: Maintain Village Skeleton
description: Update the situation graph during explicit maintenance beats as play changes the village.

runtime.contextSummary: Loaded only at explicit maintenance/reflection points to avoid quantum railroading.

safetyPolicy: Do not casually rewrite established facts mid-resolution. Log every hidden graph mutation.
outputShape: Typed graph patch, Referee Brain note, public projection delta when applicable.

title: OSE Reference / Procedure
description: Rules authority layer for source-grounded OSE procedures and safe receipt handling.

runtime.contextSummary: Loaded when a beat touches OSE procedure. May emit player-safe summaries through table artifacts.

safetyPolicy: Do not quote raw OSE text publicly. PlayerAgents do not access raw corpus.
outputShape: Procedure choice, roll needs, state mutation, receipt IDs, player-safe note if needed.

title: Monster Tactics
description: Referee-only tactics layer for hostile or dangerous creature behavior and combat-risk escalation.

runtime.contextSummary: Loaded for combat-risk or monster/NPC tactical posture. Inspiration, not rules authority.

safetyPolicy: Never override OSE procedure. Do not expose hidden tactics as public narration unless revealed by play.
outputShape: Tactical posture, likely behavior, escalation/de-escalation options, morale/reaction prompts.

title: Player Survival Tactics
description: PlayerAgent-safe survival and tactical decision support from visible state only.

sourceDocs.label: Live to Tell the Tale pointer

runtime.contextSummary: Loaded when player faces danger, combat-risk, exploration pressure, or coordination choices.

safetyPolicy: Use only player-visible projections and player-safe summaries. No hidden world state or raw rules corpus.
outputShape: Questions to ask, safe approaches, coordination ideas, retreat/regroup options.

title: Table Projection Rules
description: Defines what can appear in shared/public table projection versus private Referee and player brains.

runtime.contextSummary: On-demand table projection card. Hard privacy gates stay in code/system prompt; load this when shaping projections, monitor output, or shared table artifacts.

safetyPolicy: Never expose devReasoning, innerMonologue, privateGoal, privateFear, raw Referee notes, raw player brain, or raw corpus text.
outputShape: Allow/deny checklist for table projection fields and monitor events.
